description: This file defines data models and schemas for the backend of a financial tracking application, using Pydantic for request/response validation and SQLAlchemy compatibility. It includes enums, request and response models for users, transactions, categories, budgets, and reports.

classes.name: TransactionType
classes.description: Enum representing transaction types: expense or income.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating/registering a new user.

classes.name: UserLogin
classes.description: Pydantic model for user login requests.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for returning user details.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Model representing a JWT access token response.

classes.name: CategoryIn
classes.description: Model for creating or editing a category.

classes.name: CategoryOut
classes.description: Model for representing a category in responses.

classes.name: TransactionIn
classes.description: Model for creating or editing a transaction.

classes.name: BudgetIn
classes.description: Model for creating or updating a budget.

classes.name: BudgetOut
classes.description: Model for representing a budget record.

classes.name: DashboardSummary
classes.description: Model summarizing the dashboard view of finance data.
